title: Grow typo-RAM 0x80139c to the 36-byte WsfOs QActive; re-prove and install wsf_os_ao; prove application_boot 30ed80 with a loop-branch landing pad (no -DEM_AGAIN=0) and install; private p-wsfboot rebuild; paired Renode sims both PASS (run_renode_rc=0)

wsf_os_ao_preinstall_confirm.note: Current tree bytes before this install equalled the recorded pre-install sha256_before from the failed previous install attempt, the prove orig copy, and HEAD. Confirmation was against the pre-install sha, not merely HEAD. No other uncommitted work was present on this file. The earlier git-show-HEAD overwrite happened to restore those same bytes; this turn did not use git show HEAD to revert or install.

ram_80139c_grow.reason: Stock QActive_ctor 0x310d18 zeros r1=0x24 bytes at me; WsfOsInitOnly 0x314078 passes me=0x80139c; QActive_start_ stores prio at me+32 and inits eQueue at me+0xC. Neighbor 0x801398 is a separate nest byte; next typo-RAM object is 0x8013d0 (32 B). 0x8013c0..0x8013cf left as a 16-byte gap.
ram_80139c_grow.controller_init: Already used u32_80139c and &em9305_ram_80139c; still valid after the grow.

qemu_prove.harness: build/em-ctl/qm.py, 100 cases, dztrap, extra_next3.c, pre_wsf.h / pre_boot.h

wsf_os_ao.result: all 6 exported symbols EQUIVALENT 100 after the 36-byte grow
wsf_os_ao.static_unexported: wsf_os_active_333c44 is static and is not in the harness SYM list. It is the only user of typo-RAM objects 806034 and 806054 (handler event bits and message queue). Production reaches it through QActive dispatch; the harness pads start() so this path is not directly compared. WSF_OS_INIT_CBACK remains the literal 0x8019e4.

application_boot.boot_init_nvm: 30ecf8, 30ee78, 30ef04, 30ef0c EQUIVALENT 100 (unchanged vs prior prove; typo-RAM mutants of 80fb08 and 80f98c on 30ecf8 KILLED)

boot_loop_30ed80.method: Test-only -include em_again.h defines EM_AGAIN as opencfw_em_again(). PRE_H sets opencfw_em_again_left=1 so the do-while back-edge is taken once, then the function returns. Production source is unchanged and still uses default EM_AGAIN 1. This is not -DEM_AGAIN=0 (which compiled the back-edge away).
boot_loop_30ed80.result: EQUIVALENT 100 classes=100 calls=5759 nor0 (re-proven after mutant-safe PRE_H pads). Prior -DEM_AGAIN=0 cut proof had calls=1355; the higher call count is the second iteration.
mutants_killed: 30ed80 &em9305_ram_80fde0 -> &em9305_ram_80fb08: first attempt RUN FAILED (short 100/0) because the mutant loaded wild callback words; PRE_H then zeroed 80fb08+0x1c/+0x20 so the mutant stays in-bounds and was KILLED (ncalls/callhash/memhash). Eq re-prove after that PRE_H change stayed EQUIVALENT 100.

install.method: Wrote the already-proven typo-RAM cand bytes over the tree files (targeted install of this stream's own rewrite, not a git checkout).

tree_build.note: Same .text size as p-aoad (239316) but different sha (409a8d67… vs f7c64def…). Growing 80139c and installing wsf_os_ao compiled cleanly; the previous -Werror=array-bounds failure is gone.

splice.nor_source: copy of build/em9305-nor-20261122/nor-stock-formatted.bin, then lfs_inject at 0x1400000 path /firmware/ble_em9305.bin
